model.message: حماية التوأم بقواعد تشغيل افتراضية؛ النموذج البحثي متاح منفصلًا على بياناته العامة.
model.qualification: تطابق عددي لأول 1600 قراءة في مصدرين، على بيئة Mac الحالية فقط.
limitations: الدرجة ترتيب لشذوذ الحدث، وليست احتمال سلامة الماء أو ثقة كل حساس.
لم تثبت القدرة على تمييز أعطال الحساسات الخمسة.
مصادر التقييم سبق استخدامها في التطوير؛ ليست تحققًا ميدانيًا مستقلًا.
لا يعمم هذا التأهيل على قراءات مورد أو Raspberry Pi.
دقيقة واحدة بين القراءات، مع استبعاد أول 120 قراءة وفترة تهيئة إضافية.

design_assumptions.matched_flow_assumption: Inlet and irrigation demand equal feed; this is a steady-flow illustration, not measured building demand.
design_assumptions.continuous_reject_assumption: None. No membrane/RO rejection stage is specified; drain remains a compatibility key with zero normal reject.
design_assumptions.backwash_source: treated tank; no treatment or reuse during backwash
design_assumptions.backwash_basis: Illustrative reference3.9m3/hour; stock-bounded, not a validated pump/filter specification.
design_assumptions.recirculation_model: Design-only return branch; zero simulated flow. HOLD stops all normal transfers; no automatic diversion is inferred.
design_assumptions.dosing_model: Aggregate running/stopped indicator only; no individual chemical inventory, dosing rate, reaction, UV dose or carbon adsorption model.
design_assumptions.quality_model: Bounded illustrative signals; no chemical treatment, tank mixing or field validation claim.
design_assumptions.pressure_model: Illustrative line-pressure readings; not a validated hydraulic transient model.
design_assumptions.actuation: Virtual only. Both valves normally closed; loss of power stops every flow. No gravity diversion.
design_assumptions.overflow: Explicit unretained tank excess; discharged separately from reject and backwash.
design_assumptions.flow_basis: Instantaneous virtual rates; cumulative volumes integrate actual stock-bounded transfers.
design_assumptions.balance: initial_stored + input = stored + reuse + reject_drain + overflow + backwash

design_assumptions.matched_flow_assumption: Inlet and irrigation demand equal feed; this is a steady-flow illustration, not measured building demand.
design_assumptions.continuous_reject_assumption: None. No membrane/RO rejection stage is specified; drain remains a compatibility key with zero normal reject.
design_assumptions.backwash_source: treated tank; no treatment or reuse during backwash
design_assumptions.backwash_basis: Illustrative reference3.9m3/hour; stock-bounded, not a validated pump/filter specification.
design_assumptions.recirculation_model: Design-only return branch; zero simulated flow. HOLD stops all normal transfers; no automatic diversion is inferred.
design_assumptions.dosing_model: Aggregate running/stopped indicator only; no individual chemical inventory, dosing rate, reaction, UV dose or carbon adsorption model.
design_assumptions.quality_model: Bounded illustrative signals; no chemical treatment, tank mixing or field validation claim.
design_assumptions.pressure_model: Illustrative line-pressure readings; not a validated hydraulic transient model.
design_assumptions.actuation: Virtual only. Both valves normally closed; loss of power stops every flow. No gravity diversion.
design_assumptions.overflow: Explicit unretained tank excess; discharged separately from reject and backwash.
design_assumptions.flow_basis: Instantaneous virtual rates; cumulative volumes integrate actual stock-bounded transfers.
design_assumptions.balance: initial_stored + input = stored + reuse + reject_drain + overflow + backwash
